# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This batch contains a very large number of short WhatsApp/call snippets, but the majority are **not genuine sales conversations** — they are internal logistics chatter (vehicle/loading coordination, Porter cab cancellations, crane/driver issues, bill-copy handovers, wedding invitations, IndiaMart lead-routing calls between internal staff). These were excluded.

The **real sales calls** that remain (roughly 55–65 distinct conversations) show a consistent pattern: inbound/outbound enquiries for **color-coated metal roofing sheets** (JSW-branded, sold under sub-brand names like Coloron Plus, Pragathi, Radiance, Kalaran, Indradhanush/Asian), related **accessories** (ridge, L-flashing, gutter, flash/deep-trim cutters, down pipe), **puff/sandwich insulation panels** (supply-only), **Tata-brand screws, welding rods, cutting/grinding wheels**, and occasional **structural pipe/square-tube** enquiries. The company operates out of Manali, Chennai (near Andarkuppam check-post), is a JSW distributor, and runs a small telecalling/BD team that cold-calls IndiaMart leads as well as handles inbound dealer/retail calls. Given the volume of logistics noise relative to real sales talk, this KB is built strictly from the rate-quoting, objection-handling, and order-closing calls; it should be treated as a **working, not exhaustive**, playbook.

## Products & brand ladder

**1. Color-coated roofing sheets (core product)** — sold by thickness and brand tier:
- **JSW Coloron Plus** — the flagship/premium line. Thickness 0.47mm and 0.50mm most common; also 0.60mm mentioned (“0.47 இருக்கு, 0.50 இருக்கு, 0.60 இருக்கு” [we have 0.47, 0.50, 0.60]).
- **Pragathi** — a lower/mid brand under JSW umbrella, repeatedly offered as the "கம்மியா" (cheaper) option vs Coloron Plus.
- **Indradhanush (Asian brand)** — cheapest tier, only available in 0.45mm: “0.45-னா Indradhanush brand தான் வரும்” [for 0.45mm only Indradhanush comes].
- **Radiance, Kalaran** — other brand names quoted interchangeably by price-shopping customers ("Pragathi, Radiance" / "Kalaran வருது உங்களுக்கு ₹440").
- **Non-color/Bare/Silver** variants also sold (“Non-color Bare இருக்கு” / “Silver One Plus”).

**2. Colors available:** Sky Blue, Off White, Brick Red, Graphite/Pencil Grey (same thing, two names), Royal Blue/Nova Blue (same), Mist Green, CFG Green. Staff standard color-card line: “Sky Blue இருக்கு, Off White இருக்கு, Graph Grey color இருக்கு, Royal Blue இருக்கு… Brick Red… Non-color Bare… Mist Green.”

**3. Accessories** — Ridge, L-flashing (300×300 standard, custom to diagram), flash cutter, deep trim, down pipe (+₹250 extra on base rate), gutter (150×75 size example). Priced per piece by width band (below 610mm vs 610–1220mm).

**4. Puff / sandwich insulation panels** — sold in 30mm/40mm/50mm thickness, top & bottom sheet gauge separately quoted (e.g., top 0.40/0.35, bottom 0.35). Explicitly **supply-only**: “நாங்க insulation பண்ண மாட்டோம், நாங்க supply மட்டும் தாங்க sir பண்றோம்” [we don't do insulation/fixing, only supply].

**5. Screws & hardware** — Tata-brand self-drilling/stitching screws in multiple sizes (19mm, 25mm, 1 inch, 1.5 inch, 5.5 inch etc.), sold by carton/box (500–5000 pcs per box depending on size). Also Tata welding electrodes and cutting/grinding wheels mentioned as cross-sell items in the IndiaMart lead-routing call.
